proposals.evidence: Turner eṣa/eta explicitly gives Hindi yah, Kumauni/Nepali yo, Maithili ī, Bengali/Oriya e and Punjabi/Lahnda e/eh. The selected proximal survey pronouns are compared with this regional paradigm, retaining local gender/number vowels, y/j notation and breathiness. Distal-looking o/vo responses, hā-/ā- stems and classifier compounds are excluded.
